title: AI Aesthetics: Classic Compositional Preference Experiments on Vision-Language Models
description: Experimental code, stimuli specifications, and reports comparing vision-language models’ compositional preferences with published human results. The core study evaluated seven open-weight models. The code is licensed under MIT. Original documentation and data are licensed under CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE-docs.md for scope and third-party exceptions; raw replies from models served through the NVIDIA API are not included.
